Air Scrubber Installation in Greenville, SC

In-duct air purification installed in your HVAC system for homes throughout Greenville, SC.

An air scrubber is a purification device installed inside your HVAC ductwork, and Carolina Heating Service installs and services them throughout Greenville, SC. Instead of filtering one room the way a portable purifier does, an in-duct unit treats the air every time the system circulates it, which means the whole house gets the benefit of equipment you never see or hear.

The distinction from a standard filter matters. A filter captures particles that pass through it; an air scrubber actively treats the airstream, using UV light and a catalytic process that acts on particles, odors, and biological contaminants smaller than what standard filtration catches.

FAQs

What is the difference between an air scrubber and a better filter?

A filter is passive: it captures what happens to hit it, and finer filters restrict airflow as the price of catching more. An air scrubber actively treats the moving airstream with UV light and a catalytic surface, working on particles, odors, and organisms without adding filter resistance. Many homes run both, since they do different jobs.

Does an air scrubber help with odors?

Yes, odors are one of its stronger use cases, because odor molecules circulate with the air and pass through the unit repeatedly. Cooking, pet, and smoke odors diminish over days of operation rather than instantly, since the equipment treats air in circulation, not the sources themselves.

How much maintenance does an air scrubber need?

The active cell or UV lamp is replaced on a schedule, typically every one to two years depending on the model and runtime. There is nothing to clean or adjust between replacements, and the technician can fold the replacement into a regular maintenance visit.

Does it run all the time?

The unit operates whenever your HVAC blower moves air. Systems set to circulate on a fan schedule extend treatment beyond heating and cooling calls, and the technician can configure fan settings so the scrubber gets enough runtime to matter.

Will an air scrubber help with allergies?

It reduces the airborne particles that commonly trigger symptoms, including pollen and dander circulating through the system. Whether that translates into symptom relief varies by person, so the defensible claim is reduced exposure, and anyone managing a medical condition should weigh equipment decisions with their doctor.
